title: Bulk Inference Run Manager
subtitle: Takes a very large pile of prompts, packs them so every GPU stays busy, collects the answers after the submitting programs have gone home, and writes the results back with every item accounted for.
lede: Takes a very large pile of prompts, packs them so every GPU stays busy, collects the answers after the submitting programs have gone home, and writes the results back with every item accounted for. You get a finished dataset rather than a babysitting job.
who: An AI or ML team lead with millions of prompts to process
author: Corey James
